restoration_note: The teaching describes the prochos (Wheel) as a mirror set before the Gate of Honor — the Lord's recurring discrimination by which every claiming arrangement of the self, in any firmament above or below, is exposed. Restorations are heavily constrained by formulaic repetition: 'King of Honor,' 'Great Gate of Honor,' 'that prochos,' 'fashioned in him,' 'their root stands in him.' The line-24 parallel 'ⲥⲉⲭⲁⲗⲭ ⲥⲉⲁϩⲧ ⲛ̄ⲍⲏⲧϥ̄' anchored the line-12 restorations. Editor proposals were confirmed where Coptic morphology and spiritual sense aligned. The cluster of gaps in sections 1985–1986 (gaps 32–33), gap 24 in section 1979, and gaps 5, 12, 27 are too weakly constrained for honest restoration.
